step: cook with herb paste and water
text: Liquids other than water can serve as drava: herb juice, decoction, cow milk or cow urine (IJCPR Sneha Kalpana review).

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: 1 part herb paste (kalka), 4 parts ghee (sneha) and 16 parts water or decoction (drava).
Until a wick rolled from the paste burns without crackling and the froth has gone (sneha siddhi).
